description: Captures the deterministic effect of a scripted pistol attack against an idle zombieman near the E1M1 spawn: weapon state transition (NORMAL -> FIRE -> NORMAL), hitscan damage roll seeded by the LCG, target health delta, mobj state transition (S_POSS_RUN1 -> S_POSS_PAIN -> S_POSS_DIE1 chain), and the player's per-frame state snapshot hashes. Initial entries empty pending external reference run.
captureMethod: From 02-020 spawn, drive forward + turn to face the first zombieman, press FIRE = default.cfg key_fire 29 (LCTRL) once, capture state at FIRE press, FIRE+1, FIRE+pistol-cooldown, and FIRE+death-anim-length.
